ideas.children_he: שָׂרַי רָצְתָה מְאֹד יֶלֶד, אֲבָל לֹא הִצְלִיחָה לָלֶדֶת. לִפְעָמִים חֲלוֹם חָשׁוּב מִתְעַכֵּב וְגוֹרֵם לְעֶצֶב.
ideas.children_en: Sarai was married to Abram for a long time but had no children. She had an Egyptian maid named Hagar who was probably her personal servant.

ideas.children_he: שָׂרַי בִּקְּשָׁה מֵאַבְרָם לְהָבִיא יֶלֶד עִם הָגָר. הַהַחְלָטָה הַזֹּאת הִשְׁפִּיעָה עַל כָּל בְּנֵי הַבַּיִת.
ideas.children_en: Sarai said God stopped her from having children. She asked Abram to have a child with Hagar. Abram agreed and Hagar became his legal wife.

ideas.children_he: כְּשֶׁהָגָר נִכְנְסָה לְהֵרָיוֹן, הַקֶּשֶׁר בֵּינָהּ לְשָׂרַי נַעֲשָׂה קָשֶׁה. קִנְאָה וּפְגִיעָה בַּכָּבוֹד יְכוֹלוֹת לְהַרְחִיק אֲנָשִׁים.
ideas.children_en: Hagar got pregnant and thought the pregnancy made her more important than Sarai because having a son could make her the main wife.

ideas.children_he: שָׂרַי הִתְנַהֲגָה בְּקַשְׁיוּת כְּלַפֵּי הָגָר, וְהָגָר בָּרְחָה. כְּשֶׁמִּישֶׁהוּ נִפְגָּע, חָשׁוּב לְהַקְשִׁיב לוֹ וּלְהָגֵן עָלָיו.
ideas.children_en: Sarai said Abram wronged her because Hagar looked down on her. Abram said Hagar was still a servant. Sarai was mean to Hagar, so Hagar ran away.

ideas.children_he: מַלְאַךְ פָּגַשׁ אֶת הָגָר בַּמִּדְבָּר וְדִבֵּר אִתָּהּ. גַּם אָדָם שֶׁמַּרְגִּישׁ לְבַד זָקוּק לְמִישֶׁהוּ שֶׁיִּרְאֶה אוֹתוֹ.
ideas.children_en: God's angel found Hagar in the desert, talked with her, and told her to return to Sarai and obey her because it was best for her.

ideas.children_he: הַמַּלְאָךְ הִבְטִיחַ לְהָגָר שֶׁיִּוָּלֵד לָהּ בֵּן בְּשֵׁם יִשְׁמָעֵאל. הַשֵּׁם מַזְכִּיר שֶׁצַּעֲקָתָהּ נִשְׁמְעָה.
ideas.children_en: The angel said Hagar would have a son named Ishmael. He would grow big, be wild, fight a lot, but be respected by his family. God heard her cries.

ideas.children_he: הָגָר קָרְאָה לֵאלֹהִים אֵל רֳאִי. הִיא הִרְגִּישָׁה שֶׁמִּישֶׁהוּ רוֹאֶה אֶת כְּאֵבָהּ גַּם בַּמִּדְבָּר.
ideas.children_en: Hagar knew the angel was God's messenger and called God El Roi, meaning God who sees. The well there was named Beer Lahai Roi, between Kadesh and Bered in southern Canaan.

ideas.children_he: הָגָר יָלְדָה אֶת יִשְׁמָעֵאל, וְאַבְרָם נָתַן לוֹ אֶת שְׁמוֹ. אַחֲרֵי תְּקוּפָה קָשָׁה הִגִּיעָה הַתְחָלָה חֲדָשָׁה.
ideas.children_en: Hagar returned home, gave birth to Ishmael, and Abram named him so because God heard his cries. Abram was 86 years old when Ishmael was born.
